messages:
lucy (AE): Heads-up — enterprise signed MSA. They want a POC + committed reserve for ~100k qps-month (peaks ~5k RPS). Need a recommended reserved GPU config, burst policy, preheat/runbook, and quick price band fp16 vs 4-bit quant. Also confirm KMS + 13mo logs.
derek (sales_eng): They require p99 token latency ~200ms. Can we give a short config to paste into the quote?
mina (solutions): Recommend 6 reserved GPUs (A100-eq) with burst credits to +50% (up to 9). AZ split 3/3. KV-cache warmup typically reduces token compute ~25-35% for chat sessions.
chao (infra): Ops notes — autoscale example: min_reserved=6 max_total=9 scale_up: gpu_util>70% for 30s -> +1 gpu; scale_down: gpu_util<30% for 5m -> -1 gpu. Preheat (compact): T-120m start kv-warmup; T-90m synthetic @50% (30m); T-60m synthetic @75% (45m) validate p99; T-0 enable burst for initial 4h. Smoke cmds: ./kv-warmup --sessions 1000; ./loadgen --rps 3750 --ctx 2000 --dur 45m.
derek (sales_eng): Pricing ask — ballpark for 6-GPU baseline: fp16 ~ "$72k/mo"; 4-bit quant -> ~40-50% lower (~"$36k-$44k/mo"). Burst billed at marginal premium (~+10%). Will include in quote.
security-bot: Dedicated + customer-managed KMS + audit-forwarding covers 13mo retention; Private only if on-prem/air-gap required. Add model-license clause for third-party quant models.
lucy (AE): Can legal do a conditional SLO for p99? Customer wants contractual wording.
chao (infra): We can commit to P99 200ms only when preheat runbook and KV warmup are executed as agreed; otherwise best-effort. Add ops appendix with commands.
derek (sales_eng): Next steps: Mina posts short calc, Chao publishes preheat checklist, security adds clause. Need final AE deck numbers & quote by EOD. Ping here when done. :white_check_mark:
